headline: DOLLY 🧑‍🎤 DAD 📖 couldn't READ 📚 so she RAILED 💦 the WORLD 🌍 with FREE 📬 BOOKS 📕
text:
DOLLY 🧑‍🎤 PARTON 🎸 first 💥 LAUNCHED 🚀 her IMAGINATION 🧠 LIBRARY 📚 back 🏠 in her HOME 🏡 county 🗺️ in TENNESSEE 🌲 where her own DADDY 👨 couldn't READ 📖 a SINGLE 📖 word 🗣️ and that LIT 🔥 a fire 🔥 in her SOUL 💖 to send 📬 FREE 📚 books 📕 to MILLIONS 🧮 of little ONES 👶!! The program 📦 started as a TRIBUTE 🙏 to her SMART 🧠 but ILLITERATE 📖 Appalachian PAPA 👴 who never got to chase 🏃 his DREAMS 💭 because he couldn't decipher 🔤 those LETTERS 🔠 and Dolly 🧑‍🎤 wrote ✍️ in an open LETTER 📝 that his inability 📛 kept him from FULFILLING 🏆 all his secret WISHES 🌠 so inspiring 🧚 kids 🧒 to LOVE ❤️ reading 📖 became her LIFELONG 🕰️ MISSION 🎯!! One TOT 🧸 in DENVER 🏔️ crowned 👑 her the BOOK 📖 QUEEN 👸 while another in ALABAMA 🦞 calls 📞 her MS 🧓 DOLLY 🧑‍🎤 and a toddler 👶 in AUSTRALIA 🦘 with speech 🗣️ delays 🕒 finally SPAT 🗣️ out her FIRST 🥇 word 🗣️ ORANGE 🍊 after getting that COLOR 🖍️ book 📕 from the mail 📬 and her twin 👯 sis 🧒 lit up 😍 like a CHRISTMAS 🎄 tree 🌲!!

She PASSED 🌬️ away this WEEK 📅 at the grand age 🧓 of EIGHTY 8️⃣ but her LEGACY 🏛️ lives on through this LITERACY 📖 MACHINE 🏭 that sends 📬 one FREE 🆓 book 📕 every MONTH 📆 to children from BIRTH 🍼 until they turn FIVE 5️⃣!! It kicked off 🎉 in SEVIER 🏞️ COUNTY 🏘️ Tennessee in NINETEEN NINETY FIVE 📅 then BLASTED 🚀 across the USA 🇺🇸 in two THOUSAND 💯 before hitting CANADA 🍁 in two thousand SIX 6️⃣ the UK 🇬🇧 the next year and AUSTRALIA 🐨 in two thousand THIRTEEN 1️⃣3️⃣ plus IRELAND ☘️ in two thousand NINETEEN 1️⃣9️⃣!! By its THIRTIETH 3️⃣0️⃣ anniversary 🎂 in twenty TWENTY FIVE 📅 the program had already MAILED 📬 more than THREE HUNDRED MILLION 3️⃣0️⃣0️⃣💯💯 books 📚 which shakes out to one juicy 📦 package dropping every SEVENTY EIGHT 7️⃣8️⃣ seconds ⏱️ according to the official COUNTERS 🧮 and families everywhere are straight up OBSESSED 😍 with how it turned their bedtime routines into pure MAGIC ✨!! London MOMMY 👩 Harriet 🧔‍♀️ Anscombe signed her baby girl 👧 up at THREE 3️⃣ months old and says it straight up EMBEDDED 📍 story time 📖 into their nightly RITUAL 🕯️ so early that her FOUR 4️⃣ year old can't even REMEMBER 🧠 a life without those DOLLY 🧑‍🎤 books 📕 raining down like CONFETTI 🎉 and if she hadn't gotten them FREE 🆓 maybe she wouldn't have started reading 📖 till the kid was TWO 2️⃣ but now it's baked in like a warm 🍞 HUG 🤗!!

COLORADO ⛰️ mommy Ciara 🧑‍🍼 Fernandez Faber jumped on board EIGHT 8️⃣ years ago for her SON 👦 and his all time FAVE ❤️ book 📕 was the one DOLLY 🧑‍🎤 herself wrote called I AM A RAINBOW 🌈!! They read 📖 it almost EVERY 🌙 night and never got bored 😴 instead they acted out all the EMOTIONS 😢😄 with goofy faces 🤪 and at the back there's a little NOTE 📝 from Dolly 🧑‍🎤 about how everybody has a RAINBOW 🌈 of feelings and her boy would always point 👉 at her picture and yell THERE'S 📍 THE BOOK 📖 QUEEN 👸 which melts 💖 hearts everywhere!! Families keep RAVING 🗣️ about how perfectly CURATED 🧐 the selections are helping not just with ABCs 🔤 but also with social skills 🤝 and emotional GROWTH 🌱 like tackling bullying 🛡️ different identities 🏳️‍🌈 bravery 🦸 same sex families 👨‍❤️‍👨 and all those big kid FEELINGS 🥺 that make growing up less of a HEADACHE 🤕!! Dublin 🏙️ mom Helen Cashell got both her kids now SEVEN 7️⃣ and FIVE 5️⃣ on the list and says the themes helped them NAVIGATE 🧭 real life stuff that books from the store just don't TOUCH 🖐️ and author Selina Brown watched FOURTEEN THOUSAND 1️⃣4️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣ copies of her own book fly out to UK 👑 kids because of the program which means parents didn't have to choose between GAS ⛽ ELECTRIC ⚡ food 🍲 or buying a BOOK 📕 since Dolly 🧑‍🎤 took care of that core NEED 🥺!!

In inner city SYDNEY 🏙️ first time mom Paige Stewart watched her TWIN 👯 girls now FOUR 4️⃣ overcome speech delays 🗣️ and learning hiccups after just the SECOND 📖 book 📕 from the mail 📬 not only did they learn their COLORS 🌈 but it sparked pure JOY 😍 for reading 📖 and speaking 🗣️ turning their little world upside down in the best way possible!! She's become a full on EVANGELIST 📣 telling every parent she meets that it's honestly LIFE CHANGING 🔄 and Alabama grandma Kristina Hadley age FIFTY THREE 5️⃣3️⃣ does the same by stuffing baby shower gifts 🎁 with printed info from the Imagination Library site plus a little newborn book 📕 and a picture frame so new moms get the hint right away!! She signed her granddaughter Eillie Elaine up BEFORE 🚼 she was even born and now the almost three year old has her own shelf 🛍️ packed with DOLLY 🧑‍🎤 books 📕 and runs to the mailbox screaming MS 🧓 DOLLY 🧑‍🎤 MS DOLLY 🧑‍🎤 did you send me a BOOK 📕 today which is the CUTEST 🥹 thing you'll hear all year!! When the news hit that her lifelong IDOL 🧑‍🎤 had passed she choked up at work but knows this program will keep Dolly's MEMORY 🕯️ alive with the younger generation for YEARS 🕰️ and YEARS 🕰️ and she prays 🙏 it never stops!!

Canadian grandpa Geoff Blacklin age SIXTY SEVEN 6️⃣7️⃣ and his wife signed their grandkids up after a local doctor brought the scheme to their Manitoba region and he says the biggest flex 💪 is that Dolly 🧑‍🎤 never did it for the RECOGNITION 🏆 she just wanted to give families MORE 📦 than books 📕 she gave them LOVE ❤️ of reading 📖 precious cuddle moments 🤗 with loved ones and the chance to LEARN 📖 DREAM 💭 and grow into whatever they want to be!! All these stories would have been sweet sweet MUSIC 🎶 to Parton's ears because in the beginning her only HOPE 🙏 was to inspire the kids in her own home county but look at us now with a WORLDWIDE 🌍 program delivering a fresh book 📕 every month to well over THREE MILLION 3️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣ children and she made sure to thank all the partners who took her DREAM 💭 and made it their own!! At the very center was always her MASSIVE ❤️ for children and that special love for her DADDY 👨 who before he passed told her the Imagination Library was the most IMPORTANT 🔝 thing she had ever done and that praise meant the whole WORLD 🌍 to her because she built the whole thing as a TRIBUTE 🙌 to her dear old PAPA 📖 who couldn't read but still raised a legend!!
